d: Bright orange, spiky hair is styled into a high ponytail with long side-bangs, featuring a small tuft on top. The golden-yellow eyes are narrow and cheerful on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender, dressed in an orange and yellow high-visibility rescue jacket with black straps, a black harness, and a black undershirt, paired with black fingerless gloves featuring orange accents. Signature accessories include yellow-tinted goggles resting on the forehead and a small black walkie-talkie clipped to the chest.
